source: Linear doc 11 §3 (demo regions) and §3a (NO2 city sub-boxes); boxes are W,S,E,N in degrees
open_decision: D19 resolved 14 Nov (Parth): the Iberia box now reaches 3.5°E so the peninsular east coast (Barcelona, the Ebro delta) is inside it, and the 68-78°E box is relabelled NW South Asia because it spans the Indus plain of Pakistan as well as NW India. These are box averages, not polygons: they take in ocean and neighbouring land by construction, and the land mask decides which cells count.

regions.name: NW South Asia (NW India and the Indus plain of Pakistan)
